info.description: A page an editor builds by placing sections into its main region.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Title
edit.description: The page's name. It is shown in the sidebar, and the page's URL is derived from it.

edit.label: Standfirst
edit.description: A short introductory line shown beneath the title.

edit.label: Page shell
edit.description: The site chrome that wraps this page. Left empty, it fills itself from the default page shell.

edit.label: Page layout
edit.description: A two-column page carries a sidebar. A one-column page carries none of it — no back link, no table of contents and no side region.

edit.label: Table of contents
edit.description: Lists the sections that opted in, at the top of the sidebar. Two-column pages only.

edit.label: Archived
edit.description: Marks this page as belonging to a past festival edition. Turning it off does not un-archive a page whose event is archived.

edit.label: Side region
edit.description: What this page adds to the sidebar, below the back link and the table of contents.

edit.label: Main region
edit.description: The page itself. Only sections go here — background, spacing and anchoring all live on the section.
